record.oneLiner: One of the earliest dinosaurs, a Late Triassic predator.
record.description: Herrerasaurus was a lightly built carnivorous dinosaur of the Late Triassic of Argentina, about 6 m long, and one of the earliest dinosaurs known. Its fragmentary early finds long made its classification uncertain until a near-complete skeleton was found.

notableFacts.text: Named after Victorino Herrera, the rancher who found the first specimen.
